programmes.name_en: Flemish Child Benefit - base amount (Groeipakket)
programmes.funder: Vlaamse overheid - Agentschap Uitbetaling Groeipakket / uitbetalers (FONS, KidsLife, MyFamily...)
programmes.amount_note: 184,62 EUR/month for children born on or after 1 Jan 2019; children born before 2019 keep the old scale of 106,27 to 408,19 EUR depending on birth rank. Income-related and care supplements (sociale toeslag, zorgtoeslagen) can be added on top.

procedure_steps.detail: Automatic in most cases; otherwise apply with a Groeipakket payer (uitbetaler) of your choice

eligibility.income_note: The Groeipakket basisbedrag is unconditional — every child receives it regardless of family income; only the supplements are income-tested. The sociale toeslag is paid at full rate below a family income of EUR 40,701.59, at a reduced rate up to EUR 47,485.19 for families with 1-2 children, and up to EUR 76,560.64 for families with 3 or more children.

programmes.source_snippet: "Kinderen geboren vanaf 1 januari 2019: 184,62 euro per maand" - fixed monthly amount per child, usually paid automatically around the 8th of the month

programmes.name_en: Birth/Adoption Grant - Startbedrag (Flanders)
programmes.funder: Vlaamse overheid - uitbetalers van het Groeipakket
programmes.amount_note: 1.269,25 EUR per child at birth or adoption (indexed); can be requested from the 6th month of pregnancy

procedure_steps.detail: Apply with a Groeipakket payer from the 6th month of pregnancy

documents_required.doc: Medical proof of pregnancy or birth certificate

programmes.source_snippet: One-off premium of 1.269,25 euro at the birth or adoption of a child, paid by the Groeipakket payer

programmes.name_en: Family Allowances (Wallonia)
programmes.funder: AViQ / Caisses d'allocations familiales agreees (FAMIFED framework)
programmes.amount_note: Monthly base amount per child depends on birth rank and age (2026: roughly 162 EUR for a first child, about 305 EUR from the second), plus age supplements from 6/12/18 years and possible income-related social supplements. Paid automatically once affiliated to a family allowance fund.

eligibility.income_note: The Walloon base allowance is unconditional; only the supplements are income-tested, and the thresholds changed during 2026, so no single reliable ceiling can be given. FAMIWAL states that from 1 July 2026 the EUR 34,000.47 gross/year ceiling for single-parent families with a child born after 2020 is abolished in favour of a single ceiling corresponding to EUR 54,867.79 gross/year.

programmes.source_snippet: Since 2020 family allowances are regionalised; Wallonia applies its own scheme with base amounts rising by birth rank plus age and social supplements

programmes.name_en: Family Allowances (Brussels) - Famiris
programmes.funder: Famiris (Brussels public family allowance fund) and approved private funds
programmes.amount_note: Universal base amount per child by age bracket (0-11, 12-17, 18-24, around 168-215 EUR/month), plus income-tested social supplement (up to about 101 EUR/month for single-parent low-income families)

eligibility.income_note: The Brussels basic child allowance itself has no income ceiling. Only the supplement social is income-tested, on amounts indexed at 01/03/2026: full supplement below a household annual taxable income of EUR 40,586.52, a reduced supplement between EUR 40,586.52 and EUR 58,915.92, and nothing at or above EUR 58,915.92. Because the base benefit is universal, no single ceiling applies to the scheme.

programmes.source_snippet: Famiris is the Brussels family allowance fund paying the allocation de base plus possible income-related supplément social

programmes.name_en: Birth Grant (Wallonia)
programmes.funder: AViQ / Caisses d'allocations familiales agreees en Wallonie
programmes.amount_note: 1.395,02 EUR per child from 1 March 2026, regardless of birth rank; paid per child in case of multiple births. Can be requested from the 6th month of pregnancy.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply with a family allowance fund while pregnant; affiliation confirmed after application

documents_required.doc: Medical certificate of pregnancy / birth certificate

programmes.source_snippet: "A partir du 1er mars 2026, la prime de naissance s'eleve a 1.395,02 euro par enfant, peu importe le rang de naissance"

programmes.name_local: Prime de naissance / allocation de naissance (Bruxelles)
programmes.name_en: Birth Grant (Brussels)
programmes.funder: Famiris / Caisses d'allocations familiales agreees Bruxelles
programmes.amount_note: Higher amount for a first child (about 1.368-1.395 EUR depending on indexation date), lower amount for subsequent children (about 622-634 EUR). Paid at the earliest two months before the due date.

procedure_steps.detail: The mother applies with Famiris or another approved fund during pregnancy

programmes.source_snippet: "la prime de naissance s'eleve a 1.367,74 euros a Bruxelles. A partir du deuxieme enfant, vous recevez une allocation de 621,70 euros" (indexed amounts; multiple births get the full premium per child)

programmes.name_en: Annual School Premium (Brussels)
programmes.amount_note: Paid once a year in August per child; amount rises with age steps (starting around 25 EUR for young children, higher from 6, 12 and 18 years). Paid automatically with the family allowances.
programmes.source_snippet: Annual age-graded school premium paid automatically in August on top of Brussels family allowances

programmes.name_en: Nursery School Supplement (Flanders)
programmes.amount_note: Annual income-tested supplement (about 160 EUR) for toddlers attending nursery school sufficiently; investigated automatically by the payer

eligibility.income_note: Income-tested; linked to entitlement to the social supplement

programmes.source_snippet: Yearly supplement within the Groeipakket for 3- and 4-year-olds with sufficient attendance in Dutch-medium nursery education, for lower-income families

programmes.name_en: Foster Care Supplement (Flanders)
programmes.amount_note: 71,30 EUR per month on top of the base amount for each child placed in foster care
programmes.source_snippet: A child placed in a foster family is entitled to a pleegzorgtoeslag of 71,30 euro paid monthly on top of the Groeipakket

programmes.name_en: Support Supplement for children with care needs (Flanders)
programmes.amount_note: 346,15 EUR per month; requires a care assessment (medical-social scale, minimum 12 points); lower amounts may apply for smaller care needs

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via the Groeipakket payer; care need is assessed on the medical-social scale

documents_required.doc: Medical-social assessment of the child's care need

programmes.source_snippet: Monthly supplement of 346,15 euro for children and young people with a support need of at least 12 points on the medical-social scale

programmes.name_en: School Bonus (Flanders)
programmes.amount_note: 23,07 EUR (0-4y), 40,38 EUR (5-11y), 57,68 EUR (12-17y), 69,22 EUR (18-24y); income-tested via the social supplement

eligibility.income_note: Requires entitlement to the income-tested social supplement

programmes.source_snippet: Schoolbonus paid each year in August if the child was entitled to the sociale toeslag in July; 23,07 to 69,22 euro depending on age

programmes.name_en: Child benefit for federal civil servants (FAMIFED)
programmes.funder: FAMIFED - Federaal agentschap voor de kinderbijslag
programmes.amount_note: Amounts depend on birth rank, age and family situation; FAMIFED applies the regional system linked to the child's residence for most new entitlements
programmes.source_snippet: FAMIFED is the federal family allowance agency paying child benefits for children of federal civil servants, with supplements by rank and situation

programmes.name_local: Schooltoelage (kleuter-, lager en secundair onderwijs, Vlaanderen)
programmes.name_en: School Allowance for nursery/primary/secondary pupils (Flanders)
programmes.amount_note: Annual amount per child depends on school level and household income (roughly 70 to 2.000+ EUR for secondary boarding/technical tracks); investigated and paid automatically by the Groeipakket payer

eligibility.income_note: Income-tested; household income below yearly indexed ceilings

programmes.source_snippet: Income-tested yearly school allowance within the Groeipakket for children in nursery, primary or secondary education; amount varies with education type and family income

programmes.name_en: Study Grant for Higher Education (Flanders)
programmes.amount_note: Yearly grant roughly between 400 and 5.500 EUR depending on household income, family size and living situation (kot); paid once per academic year. Includes right to reduced tuition fee and cheaper student housing/meals.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via the Digitaal loket Studietoelagen before the deadline
Provide income and family data; the service decides and informs the institution about reduced tuition

eligibility.income_note: Income-tested; entitlement depends on household taxable income and number of dependants

programmes.source_snippet: "De studietoelage dient als financiele ondersteuning om studiekosten te dekken... Het is een bedrag dat je een keer per academiejaar ontvangt als je voldoet aan alle voorwaarden"

programmes.name_en: Reduced Tuition Fee for higher education (scholarship rate)
programmes.amount_note: Grant holders pay a strongly reduced enrolment fee (beurstarief); students just above the grant income threshold pay an intermediate rate (bijna-beurstarief). Applied by the institution after the Studietoelagen service passes on the rate.

eligibility.income_note: Reduced tuition follows the Flemish studietoelage income test, which publishes a maximum income limit per 'points' in the leefeenheid for academic year 2026-2027: 0 points EUR 23,033.45 (the base case, e.g. a self-supporting single student), 1 point EUR 34,017.98, 2 points EUR 42,617.59, rising with household size and dependants.

programmes.source_snippet: "Krijg je een studietoelage voor het hoger onderwijs? Dan heb je ook recht op verminderd studiegeld bij je onderwijsinstelling in Vlaanderen"

programmes.name_en: Study Grants (French Community)
programmes.funder: Federation Wallonie-Bruxelles - Service des allocations et prets d'etudes
programmes.amount_note: Yearly amount depends on household income and study level (from a few hundred up to several thousand EUR per year); application each academic year via the allocation service
programmes.deadline_note: Yearly application window per academic year

eligibility.income_note: Income-tested; household income ceilings apply

programmes.source_snippet: Annual income-tested study grant of the French Community for students in secondary, higher and university education in the Wallonia-Brussels Federation

programmes.name_en: VDAB - free vocational training and career guidance
programmes.funder: VDAB (Vlaamse Dienst voor Arbeidsbemiddeling en Beroepsopleiding)
programmes.amount_note: Training courses and guidance are free for registered jobseekers; many courses also open (free or cheap) to workers and school leavers
programmes.source_snippet: VDAB offers free vocational training courses, career counselling and job matching for jobseekers and workers in Flanders

programmes.name_en: Civic Integration Programme - free integration course
programmes.funder: Agentschap Integratie en Inburgering (Vlaanderen) / Bruxelles accueil / CRIS (Wallonie)
programmes.amount_note: The integration course and guidance are free of charge for registered newcomers
programmes.source_snippet: Newcomers entitled or obliged to civic integration receive a free integration trajectory including Dutch lessons pathway, social orientation course and career guidance

programmes.name_en: Unemployment Benefits (RVA/ONEM)
programmes.funder: Rijksdienst voor Arbeidsvoorziening (RVA/ONEM) via uitbetalingsinstellingen (vakbond, CAPAC/HVW)
programmes.amount_note: Percentage of last gross wage (65% first 3 months, 60% afterwards) within wage ceilings, later a flat amount depending on cohabitation status; minimum and maximum daily amounts apply. From 2026 entitlement is limited in time (generally max 2 years, longer with longer careers).

procedure_steps.detail: Register as jobseeker with the regional employment service (VDAB, Actiris, Le Forem, ADG)
Apply for benefits via a union or the CAPAC/HVW with form C1 and eID

eligibility.income_note: Amount depends on previous wage and family situation

programmes.source_snippet: First compensation period: 65% of last wage (capped, highest wage ceiling 4.265,98 EUR/month) during the first 3 months, then 60%; afterwards a flat-rate amount by family situation. New rules from 01.03.2026 including time limitation.

programmes.name_en: Insertion Benefits for School Leavers
programmes.amount_note: Flat daily/monthly amount depending on age and family situation (lower for under-18s and cohabitants, higher for singles and heads of household); entitlement after a waiting period of roughly 6-12 months depending on age

procedure_steps.detail: Register with the regional employment service right after finishing studies and apply with union or CAPAC

documents_required.doc: Diploma / proof of end of studies

eligibility.income_note: Flat amounts by category, not linked to previous wage

programmes.source_snippet: Flat-rate benefit for young people who finished studies and remain registered as jobseeker after a waiting period (wachttijd) based on age

programmes.name_en: Temporary Unemployment (economic reasons / force majeure)
programmes.amount_note: Usually 65-70% of the last capped daily wage per suspended day; employer procedures via DRS scenario

eligibility.income_note: Based on capped last wage

programmes.source_snippet: Benefits for workers temporarily suspended by their employer for economic reasons or force majeure; in 2026 temporary unemployment is a percentage of the capped daily wage

programmes.name_en: Career Break / Time Credit with Reason (RVA allowance)
programmes.amount_note: Forfaitary amounts (2026, indicative net): ~770 EUR/month full-time interruption, ~385 EUR half-time, ~195 EUR for 1/5 reduction with at least 5 years seniority; slightly lower with less seniority. Requires 36 months seniority with the employer (since 2026).

documents_required.doc: Proof of the motive (medical certificate, school enrolment...)

programmes.source_snippet: Flat RVA allowance during full-time, half-time or 1/5 career break with a recognised reason (care for child under 12/21, palliative care, serious illness, training of at least 360 hours); 2026 net amounts roughly 770 EUR (full-time) / 385 EUR (half-time) with 5 years seniority

programmes.name_en: End-of-career Time Credit (landing job from age 55)
programmes.amount_note: Higher flat allowances than ordinary time credit; amount depends on the reduction (1/2 or 1/5), age and sector; long career record required (generally 24-25 years)
programmes.source_snippet: Older workers (55+, sometimes 50+ in heavy occupations) can reduce working time to half-time or 4/5 in a landing job with a higher RVA allowance, subject to a long career condition

programmes.name_en: Early Retirement Scheme - unemployment with company supplement
programmes.amount_note: Consists of the ordinary unemployment benefit plus a flat employer supplement (bedrijfstoeslag) that compensates part of the lost wage; age and career conditions vary by situation
programmes.source_snippet: Dismissed older workers can receive unemployment benefits plus a monthly company supplement until pension age; minimum age and career conditions apply (generally 60+ after restructuring, earlier after long careers)

programmes.name_local: Studentenarbeid - 650 uren aan verminderde sociale bijdragen
programmes.name_en: Student Jobs - 650 hours at reduced social contributions
programmes.amount_note: Student pays 2,71% instead of 13,07% social contributions and no payroll tax within the 650-hour quota; parents keep child benefit (Groeipakket) and the student stays fiscally dependent within income limits

procedure_steps.detail: Sign a student employment contract; employer files a Dimona STU declaration; track hours via student@work

programmes.source_snippet: Students can work 650 hours per calendar year paying only a solidarity contribution of 2,71% (employer 5,42-5,43%) instead of ordinary social contributions, and pay no withholding tax within the quota

programmes.name_en: Flexi-job scheme (reduced contributions for side jobs)
programmes.amount_note: No ordinary employee social contributions; flexi-job income is tax-free up to a yearly ceiling (about 12.000 EUR); employer pays a special contribution of 25-28%

eligibility.income_note: FOD Financien publishes an annual indexed cap on tax-exempt flexi-job pay: EUR 18,000 for income year 2025 and EUR 18,440 for income year 2026. The cap applies per person across all flexi-job employers; the excess is taxed as ordinary pay. Pensioners are fully exempt with no cap.

programmes.source_snippet: Workers already employed at least 4/5 (or pensioners, teachers from a certain age) can take a flexi-job in horeca, retail and other listed sectors without employee social contributions and with tax-free pay within limits

programmes.name_local: Tewerkstelling in het kader van artikel 60, §7 (OCMW/CPAS)
programmes.name_en: Article 60 employment via the Public Social Welfare Centre
programmes.amount_note: The beneficiary's RIS/benefit is used to fund the employment; worker receives an ordinary pay slip and builds pension and holiday rights

eligibility.income_note: For persons entitled to social integration income (leefloon/RIS)

programmes.source_snippet: The OCMW/CPAS can hire a social assistance beneficiary with an employer using their benefit as the wage subsidy, giving a paid job, training path and preservation of social rights

programmes.name_en: Flemish Support Premium for employers hiring target groups
programmes.amount_note: Paid in instalments over up to 2 years; total between roughly 500 and 11.000 EUR depending on the target group and employment duration

procedure_steps.detail: Notify VDAB within the deadline after hiring and apply online

programmes.source_snippet: Premium for Flemish employers who hire a jobseeker from a disadvantaged target group (young low-skilled, older workers, persons with disabilities, long-term unemployed...) for at least half-time

programmes.name_en: Actiris - hiring incentives (Brussels)
programmes.amount_note: Amount and duration depend on the specific measure and the jobseeker's profile; applied for by the employer with Actiris
programmes.source_snippet: Brussels employers can receive hiring incentives (activation of unemployment benefits and other premiums) when engaging registered Brussels jobseekers, notably in training paths

programmes.name_en: Service Vouchers for subsidised household help
programmes.funder: Gewesten (VDAB / Le Forem / Actiris via Pluxee) - RSZ framework
programmes.amount_note: User pays a fixed price per voucher (about 10-11 EUR per hour of work) while the region subsidises the actual wage cost; Wallonia still grants a tax reduction of 0,90 EUR per voucher on the first 150 vouchers

procedure_steps.detail: Register with the voucher issuer (Pluxee/Sodexo) and order vouchers; book a worker via an approved agency

programmes.source_snippet: "Sinds 2025 is de belastingvermindering voor dienstencheques geschrapt in het Vlaams Gewest; sinds 2026 ook in het Brussels Gewest. In Wallonie blijft een vermindering van 0,90 euro per cheque (eerste 150 cheques)." The voucher itself buys one hour of subsidised household help.

programmes.name_en: Social Integration Income (subsistence minimum via OCMW/CPAS)
programmes.funder: OCMW/CPAS (federal law on the right to social integration)
programmes.amount_note: From 1 March 2026: 893,65 EUR/month (cohabitant), 1.340,47 EUR (single), 1.811,57 EUR (with dependent family). Partial RIS possible to top up lower income.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at the OCMW/CPAS of your municipality; social and means investigation follows
Sign an individualised social integration project (PIIS/GPMI) within 3 months

documents_required.doc: Proof of income and household composition

eligibility.income_note: Household means-tested; own income below the RIS amount

programmes.source_snippet: "A partir du 1er mars 2026, le montant du RIS est de: cohabitant 893,65 euros; isole 1.340,47 euros; personne avec famille a charge 1.811,57 euros" - identical amounts for all CPAS

programmes.name_local: Inkomensvervangende tegemoetkoming (IVT) voor personen met een handicap
programmes.name_en: Income Replacement Allowance for persons with disabilities
programmes.funder: FOD Sociale Zekerheid - DG Personen met een Handicap
programmes.amount_note: Monthly amount depends on household category (living alone / cohabiting / with dependants) and own income; indexed yearly with an additional increase for single persons in 2026

procedure_steps.detail: Apply to DG Personen met een Handicap; medical and social investigation follows

eligibility.income_note: Income-tested per household category

programmes.source_snippet: Monthly allowance for adults whose disability reduces their capacity to earn an income to one third or less; category B (living alone) increased by an extra 2% in 2026

programmes.name_local: Integratietegemoetkoming (IT) voor personen met een handicap
programmes.name_en: Integration Allowance for persons with disabilities
programmes.funder: FOD Sociale Zekerheid - DG Personen met een Handicap
programmes.amount_note: Amount depends on the category of reduced autonomy (I to V), not on income; can be combined with the IVT
programmes.source_snippet: Monthly allowance compensating reduced autonomy for persons with a recognised disability; from 2026 paid only via bank account

programmes.name_en: Guaranteed Income for Older Persons
programmes.amount_note: Tops income up to the guaranteed amount for your category (single / cohabiting); paid monthly by the Federal Pension Service; gives access to extra advantages (e.g. social tariffs)

procedure_steps.detail: Apply with the Federal Pension Service (often investigated automatically with a pension file)

eligibility.income_note: The Federale Pensioendienst states you qualify if your monthly means are below EUR 1,611.96 for a single person, or EUR 1,074.64 for a cohabitant, at index 183.17 applicable from 01.03.2026 — i.e. EUR 19,343.52/year single and EUR 12,895.68/year cohabiting. The means test covers 90% of pensions, professional and replacement income, property and capital.

programmes.source_snippet: Means-tested top-up to a guaranteed minimum income for persons aged 65+ whose resources are below the threshold

programmes.name_en: Reception and material aid for asylum seekers (Fedasil)
programmes.funder: Fedasil - Federaal agentschap voor de opvang van asielzoekers
programmes.amount_note: In-kind support: accommodation, food, hygiene, medical assistance and a pocket-money allowance; no cash integration income during the asylum procedure
programmes.source_snippet: Asylum seekers are entitled to reception (housing, meals, clothing, medical care and a small daily allowance) in a Fedasil or partner centre during their procedure

programmes.name_en: UiTPAS at social rate (80% discount on culture, sports and leisure)
programmes.funder: UiTPAS (publiq, met Vlaamse en lokale overheden)
programmes.amount_note: 80% discount on tickets and memberships of participating cultural, sports and youth organisations; entitlement to the social rate is verified via income data (e.g. verhoogde tegemoetkoming, leefloon)

procedure_steps.detail: Buy a UiTPAS; the social rate is granted automatically if registers confirm a low income, or via proof from OCMW/CPAS

documents_required.doc: Proof of low-income status where not retrieved automatically

eligibility.income_note: For people with low income (automatic check via e.g. increased reimbursement status or CPAS attestation)

programmes.source_snippet: "Wie een UiTPAS aan kansentarief heeft, krijgt 80% korting" - people with a low income pay only 20% of the price for culture, sports and youth activities in participating regions

programmes.name_en: Social tariff for telecom (internet/telephony discount)
programmes.amount_note: Fixed monthly discount defined by federal rules on a basic subscription; usually applied automatically after status check or on request to the operator

eligibility.income_note: Reserved to protected low-income categories

programmes.source_snippet: Certain protected categories (e.g. persons entitled to verhoogde tegemoetkoming, IGO, IVT) get a discount on a basic internet or telecom subscription with participating operators

programmes.name_local: Gratis of gesubsidieerde juridische bijstand (eerste en tweede lijn)
programmes.name_en: Free or subsidised legal aid
programmes.funder: Bureaus voor juridische bijstand / Bureaux d'aide juridique (FOD Justitie)
programmes.amount_note: First line free for all; second line fully free below income thresholds, or with a client contribution of 25-125 EUR depending on income

eligibility.income_note: Income thresholds per household category; some categories (minors, RIS beneficiaries) always free

programmes.source_snippet: Free first-line legal information for everyone; free or partly free second-line legal assistance (pro-Deo lawyer) depending on income and situation

programmes.name_en: Increased Reimbursement status for health care (low income)
programmes.amount_note: Lower patient share on nearly all reimbursed care (higher reimbursement percentage); granted automatically with certain benefits (leefloon, IGO, IVT...) or on income test at the health insurance fund; unlocks many linked advantages (social tariffs, cheaper transport, reduced zorgpremie)

procedure_steps.detail: Automatic with qualifying benefits, otherwise apply at your ziekenfonds with proof of income

documents_required.doc: Proof of income (tax assessment or benefit attestation)

eligibility.income_note: RIZIV/INAMI publishes hard annual ceilings on gross household taxable income. For applications made in 2026 assessed on the previous year's income: EUR 28,054.93 for a one-person household, +EUR 5,193.74 per additional household member. For the 'current income' route the ceiling is EUR 28,662.69 from 01.03.2026 and rises to EUR 29,236.66 from 01.09.2026.

programmes.source_snippet: "De verhoogde tegemoetkoming (VT) is de nieuwe naam voor het vroegere BIM-statuut. Het is een regeling die zorgt voor een verlaagd tarief voor gezondheidszorg" - lower personal share for doctor visits, medicines and treatments for low-income people

programmes.name_en: Maximum Billing - annual cap on out-of-pocket health costs
programmes.amount_note: Annual out-of-pocket ceiling per family, scaled by net taxable household income (roughly 527 EUR to over 2.300 EUR); fixed lower ceiling for social-MAF (VT status), children under 19 and chronic patients. Refunded automatically.

eligibility.income_note: Ceiling depends on net taxable family income

programmes.source_snippet: "Als de medische kosten van u en uw gezinsleden in de loop van het jaar een maximumbedrag bereiken, dan betaalt uw ziekenfonds de kosten die daar later nog bijkomen volledig terug" - income-MAF ceiling depends on net taxable family income; social MAF 527,27 EUR (2025), child MAF 761,61 EUR (2025)

programmes.name_local: Omnio-statuut (chronisch zieken met hoog eigen aandeel)
programmes.name_en: OMNIO status for chronically ill patients
programmes.amount_note: Increased reimbursement (lower personal share) granted automatically when cumulative health costs exceed indexed thresholds and income is below the ceiling

eligibility.income_note: The separate OMNIO status no longer exists: RIZIV merged it with the RVV status into the single verhoogde tegemoetkoming in the 2014 reform, so there is no distinct OMNIO income ceiling. The applicable ceiling is the verhoogde tegemoetkoming one (EUR 28,054.93 for a one-person household for 2026 applications).

programmes.source_snippet: Patients with high medical costs over consecutive years and limited income receive the omnio status: increased reimbursement similar to the VT status without having to apply

programmes.name_en: Third-party payer system (no advance payment at the doctor/pharmacist)
programmes.amount_note: Avoids advancing the full fee: only the personal share (remgeld) is paid on the spot
programmes.source_snippet: Patients (in particular with verhoogde tegemoetkoming or omnio status) pay only their personal share at the doctor or pharmacist; the health insurance fund pays the rest directly

programmes.name_en: Primary psychological care reimbursement (RIZIV networks)
programmes.amount_note: Per session: free under 24; 11 EUR for adults (4 EUR with VT status); 2,5 EUR for group sessions; first session always free. Up to 8-10 individual sessions per 12 months (extendable to 20 for treatment).

procedure_steps.detail: Book directly with a clinical psychologist/orthopedagogue affiliated with a RIZIV network; no prescription needed

programmes.source_snippet: "Voor volwassenen vanaf 24 jaar betaalt de patient 11 euro per individuele sessie (4 euro met verhoogde tegemoetkoming); voor kinderen en jongeren tot 23 jaar volledig gedekt. De eerste sessie is altijd gratis."

programmes.name_en: Chronic illness status (extra protection in health costs)
programmes.amount_note: Reduction of the MAF ceiling (about 117 EUR) and application of the third-party payer system; automatic for 2-5 years
programmes.source_snippet: Automatically granted to patients with at least 400,20 EUR health costs per quarter during 8 consecutive quarters (2025 indexed): lower MAF ceiling and third-party payer system

programmes.name_en: Free childhood vaccinations (Kind & Gezin, Flanders)
programmes.amount_note: Consultations and the basic vaccination programme are free for children up to 6 years
programmes.source_snippet: Free consultation centres and free recommended vaccinations for babies and children in Flanders, plus development follow-up

programmes.name_en: Breast cancer screening (free mammography every 2 years)
programmes.amount_note: Free mammography on invitation every 2 years (ages 50-69)
programmes.source_snippet: Women aged 50-69 are invited every 2 years for a free screening mammography within the population screening programme

programmes.name_en: Colorectal cancer screening (free stool test every 2 years)
programmes.amount_note: Free iFOB stool test sent by invitation every 2 years (ages 50-74)
programmes.source_snippet: Men and women aged 50-74 receive a free stool test by post every two years for early detection of colorectal cancer

programmes.name_en: Flemish care insurance - monthly care budget for heavy care needs
programmes.funder: Vlaamse Sociale Bescherming via de zorgkassen
programmes.amount_note: Monthly care budget of roughly 130-170 EUR (higher for persons with limited income or heavier needs); requires affiliation and a care-need assessment

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at your zorgkas; a care assessment by a team follows

eligibility.income_note: The zorgbudget voor zwaar zorgbehoevenden has no income test and no income ceiling: it is a flat EUR 140 per month, tax-free, granted on proof of heavy long-term care need plus residence and affiliation with a zorgkas. The income-tested benefit is a different one, the zorgbudget voor ouderen met een zorgnood.

programmes.source_snippet: Persons affiliated to the Flemish Social Protection who need permanent help with daily living receive a monthly care budget; financed by the yearly zorgpremie (100 EUR in 2026, 35 EUR reduced)

programmes.name_en: Allowance for Assistance to the Elderly (Flanders)
programmes.amount_note: Monthly amount depends on the self-reliance score and income; application via the zorgkas with a BEL assessment

eligibility.income_note: Income-tested

programmes.source_snippet: Allowance for people aged 60+ with reduced self-reliance (score on the BEL scale) and limited income to help pay for assistance and services

programmes.name_en: Social rental housing (Flanders)
programmes.amount_note: Rent is calculated on household income (typically well below market rent, e.g. 200-700 EUR/month); registration and income limits apply

procedure_steps.detail: Register with the local social housing company (proof of income, household composition)
Wait for allocation according to the local allocation rules

eligibility.income_note: Income ceilings per household type; priority rules apply

programmes.source_snippet: Subsidised rental homes let by social housing companies at income-dependent rents to registered candidates on the waiting list

programmes.name_en: Flemish renovation and energy premium
programmes.amount_note: 20-50% of the capped net invoice amount depending on income category (lowest incomes 50%); per-work caps apply; apply online within 2 years of the final invoice

procedure_steps.detail: Check your income category in the simulator, then apply via Mijn VerbouwLoket with invoices

eligibility.income_note: Income categories set by yearly indexed thresholds (2026: e.g. single cat 4 up to about 24.750 EUR)

programmes.source_snippet: "Mijn VerbouwPremie is een premie van de Vlaamse overheid voor renovatie en energiebesparende investeringen" - 4 income categories: 50% (cat 4), 35% (cat 3), 25% (cat 2), 20% (cat 1) of the invoice; from 1 March 2026 the two highest categories only qualify for heat pump (boiler) premiums

programmes.name_en: Flemish renovation loan at reduced interest
programmes.amount_note: Renovation loan up to 60.000 EUR at a reduced interest rate scaled by income category (lowest categories get the cheapest rates, down to 0-2%)

eligibility.income_note: Interest rate depends on income category

programmes.source_snippet: "kunt u ook de voordelige Mijn VerbouwLening tot 60.000 euro aanvragen... Sinds 2026 werd Mijn VerbouwLening nog interessanter voor de laagste inkomenscategorieen"

programmes.name_en: Flemish Adaptation Premium for seniors
programmes.amount_note: Covers 50% of the cost of adaptation works (e.g. bathroom, access) with a maximum premium; income limit 2026: 39.300 EUR single, 55.010 EUR with partner/dependant, +4.410 EUR per extra dependant

eligibility.income_note: 2026 ceilings: 39.300 EUR (single), 55.010 EUR (couple or +1 dependant), +4.410 EUR per additional dependant

programmes.source_snippet: "Het inkomen van alle 65-plussers mag niet meer bedragen dan 39.300 euro voor een aanvrager zonder persoon ten laste (aanvragen in 2026)" - premium to adapt the home for an older resident

programmes.name_en: Energy and housing renovation grants (Wallonia)
programmes.funder: Service public de Wallonie (SPW) - guichet des primes
programmes.amount_note: Premium amounts depend on the type of work and the applicant's income category (higher rates and bonuses for low incomes); applications via the online Walloon premiums counter

eligibility.income_note: No current ceiling could be confirmed. The Walloon government's February 2025 temporary support regime capped eligibility at a household reference income of EUR 114,400 (less EUR 5,000 per dependent child), but the same announcement flagged a new overall regime for 2026 which could not be verified on an official page.

programmes.source_snippet: Walloon grants for energy audits, insulation, heating and renovation works, with amounts scaled by income category and a possible audit bonus

programmes.name_en: Renolution renovation and energy premiums (Brussels)
programmes.amount_note: Premiums cover roughly 20-70% of costs depending on work and income category. IMPORTANT: at the time of writing no new applications can be filed for invoices from 2025 or 2026 (regime suspended); check renolution.brussels for the current status.
programmes.deadline_note: Currently suspended for 2025/2026 invoices pending government decision

eligibility.income_note: Income categories A/B/C modulate the premium

programmes.source_snippet: Brussels premium system (since 2022) bundling renovation, energy and facade premiums in about 47 categories, scaled by income category; note: applications for invoices dated 2025/2026 are suspended pending a government decision

programmes.name_en: ECORENO renovation credit at preferential rates (Brussels)
programmes.funder: Fonds du Logement de la Region de Bruxelles-Capitale (with Homegrade, Reseau Habitat)
programmes.amount_note: Reduced-rate loan for energy renovation (consumer credit capped at 25.000 EUR; mortgage credit for bigger projects); free simulation on the Fonds du Logement site

procedure_steps.detail: Simulate the credit online and submit a file with the Fonds du Logement

programmes.source_snippet: Renovation credit available again since January 2026 at preferential rates of about 2,5-3,5%; consumer credit up to 25.000 EUR or mortgage credit for larger energy renovations

programmes.name_en: Social letting agency (affordable private rental)
programmes.amount_note: Rent is capped and income-related, below market level; tenant registers with the local SVK and income conditions apply

eligibility.income_note: Social rental housing in Flanders uses indexed income ceilings for registration in 2026: EUR 31,361 for a single person without dependants, EUR 33,988 for a single person with a disability, and EUR 47,039 in all other cases, plus EUR 2,629 per dependant. A separate asset test and a no-property condition also apply. Brussels and Wallonia set their own ceilings.

programmes.source_snippet: Social letting agencies rent out private homes below market price to low-income tenants and manage the property for the owner

programmes.name_en: Rental premium for waiting-list candidates (Brussels)
programmes.amount_note: Monthly amount depends on household composition and income; paid while waiting for a social dwelling, subject to conditions on the private dwelling

eligibility.income_note: Same income conditions as social housing registration

programmes.source_snippet: Monthly premium for households registered on the Brussels social housing waiting list who rent on the private market

programmes.name_en: Reduced registration tax on own home purchase (Flanders)
programmes.amount_note: 2% on the purchase price (3% for a second property? no - 12% standard); 1% with commitment to thorough energy renovation of the only own home

procedure_steps.detail: Ask your notary to apply the reduced rate in the deed

programmes.source_snippet: Purchase of the only own home in Flanders is taxed at 2% registration duties instead of 12%, and at 1% when committing to a thorough energy renovation (since 1 January 2024)

programmes.name_en: Social energy tariff for protected customers
programmes.amount_note: All-in per-kWh price about 30% below the average market price; applies automatically to protected customers (certain benefits/statuses such as leefloon, VT, IVT, OCMW budget guidance) or on application

eligibility.income_note: The federal sociaal tarief has no income ceiling. FOD Economie grants it purely on category membership: you or a household member must receive a qualifying benefit (leefloon/OCMW aid, IGO, disability allowances, zorgbudget), or you rent a social apartment with collective gas heating. The temporary extension to holders of the verhoogde tegemoetkoming ended on 30 June 2023.

programmes.source_snippet: "In vergelijking met de gemiddelde marktprijs zijn de sociale tarieven voor gas en elektriciteit ongeveer 30% lager" - federally regulated all-in tariff for protected customers, revised quarterly by the CREG and identical at every supplier

programmes.name_en: Financial contribution for minimum energy supply (heating costs, vulnerable families)
programmes.amount_note: Winter contributions per half month, varying by dwelling type and protected-customer status; amounts recalculated each winter on the basis of current tariffs

eligibility.income_note: For vulnerable households incl. protected customers of the social tariff

programmes.source_snippet: "Ook in winter 2025-2026 is er financiele tussenkomst voor de verwarmingskosten van kwetsbare gezinnen" - half-monthly contributions e.g. 31,66 to 54,66 EUR (protected customers) for gas and 78,77 to 135,77 EUR for electricity depending on dwelling type

programmes.name_en: Social drinking water tariff
programmes.amount_note: Details differ by region/water company: reduction on the invoice or free basic volume for protected low-income customers; usually automatic via status exchange or on request

eligibility.income_note: No income ceiling is published: the Flemish sociaal tarief voor water (80% discount) is granted on the basis of a qualifying status — receipt of the inkomensgarantie voor ouderen, an inkomensvervangende or integratietegemoetkoming, or the zorgbudget voor ouderen met een zorgnood — evidenced by an attest. Brussels and Wallonia run separate arrangements.

programmes.source_snippet: Protected customers pay a reduced price or receive a free basic quantity of drinking water depending on the region and water company

programmes.name_en: STIB annual pass 65+ for 12 EUR (Brussels residents)
programmes.amount_note: 12 EUR/year for residents of the Brussels-Capital Region aged 65+; 60 EUR/year for 65+ living outside Brussels. Loaded on a personal MOBIB card.

procedure_steps.detail: Buy at a BOOTIK/GO point or online and load on a personal MOBIB card

programmes.source_snippet: "From 1 July 2023, over 65s in Brussels will be able to enjoy an annual pass for 12 EUR, amounting to just 1 EUR a month"; for seniors living outside Brussels the 65+ annual pass costs 60 EUR

programmes.name_en: De Lijn annual pass for seniors (Flanders)
programmes.amount_note: 71 EUR for 12 months unlimited travel (+ 10 EUR one-off MOBIB card fee per 5 years). Persons with a disability travel free (PMH), and low-income travellers can get the Omnipas Vervoersgarantie.

eligibility.income_note: No income test: the Omnipas 65+ is an age-based annual season ticket, EUR 71 for 12 months (plus EUR 10 for the MOBIB card), for anyone aged 65 or over travelling on De Lijn. Municipalities may cover 10-75% of the cost.

programmes.source_snippet: "Met de Omnipas 65+ reis je voor slechts 71 euro een heel jaar lang onbeperkt met alle bussen en (Kust)trams van De Lijn in Vlaanderen en Brussel"

programmes.name_local: NMBS/SNCB abonnementen voor scholieren en studenten
programmes.name_en: SNCB school and student season tickets
programmes.amount_note: School season ticket price depends on trajectory; youth products such as the Go Pass 10 (10 journeys at reduced price) are for under-26s
programmes.source_snippet: Discounted school season tickets for pupils and students commuting by train, plus youth fares (Go Pass 10, Youth Multi) for occasional travel under 26

programmes.name_en: De Lijn youth annual pass (12-24 years)
programmes.amount_note: Low fixed yearly price for unlimited travel (around 60 EUR/year, indexed); children under 12 travel free when accompanied
programmes.source_snippet: Strongly discounted annual season ticket for young people aged 12 to 24 on all De Lijn buses and trams in Flanders

programmes.name_en: Tax-free bicycle allowance for commuting
programmes.funder: Via de werkgever (federale fiscale en sociale vrijstelling)
programmes.amount_note: Up to 0,36 EUR per cycled kilometre (indexed yearly), exempt from tax and social contributions; paid by the employer for home-work trips. Compulsory in the private sector since 2023 (cao 164).
programmes.source_snippet: "De fiscaal vrijgestelde fietsvergoeding ligt vandaag op maximaal 0,36 euro per kilometer (inkomstenjaar 2025, aanslagjaar 2026)" - since cao nr 164 a bicycle allowance is a right in the private sector

programmes.name_local: Gratis reizen met De Lijn voor personen met een handicap (PMH)
programmes.name_en: Free De Lijn travel for persons with disabilities
programmes.amount_note: Free travel on De Lijn buses and trams for recognised persons with a disability (free PMH pass)

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via De Lijn with proof of recognition of the disability

programmes.source_snippet: "Personen met een handicap (PMH-abonnement) kunnen gratis reizen met De Lijn" via their Omnipas; companions of certain categories travel free on several Belgian networks

programmes.name_local: Europese parkeerkaart voor personen met een handicap
programmes.name_en: European parking card for persons with disabilities
programmes.amount_note: Card itself is free or cheap (municipal administrative fee possible); parking advantages vary by municipality
programmes.source_snippet: Parking card giving access to reserved parking spaces and local parking advantages, valid across the EU

programmes.name_en: Pension savings tax reduction (third pillar)
programmes.amount_note: 30% reduction on deposits up to 1.050 EUR (max advantage 315 EUR + saved municipal tax) or 25% up to 1.350 EUR (max 337,50 EUR). Ages 18-64. Ceilings frozen until 2030.

procedure_steps.detail: Open a pension savings fund/insurance with a bank or insurer and declare deposits in your tax return

programmes.source_snippet: "basisplafond van maximaal 1050 euro: belastingvermindering van 30%... verhoogde plafond van maximaal 1350 euro: belastingvermindering van 25%" (2026)

programmes.name_en: Long-term savings tax reduction (life insurance)
programmes.amount_note: 30% reduction; maximum premium around 2.530 EUR/year (2026) i.e. up to ~759 EUR advantage, but the basket is shared with mortgage capital repayments that give a regional housing tax benefit
programmes.source_snippet: 30% tax reduction on premiums for long-term savings life insurance, with a 2026 maximum savings amount of about 2.530 EUR depending on net taxable professional income

programmes.name_local: Belastingvermindering voor giften aan erkende instellingen
programmes.name_en: Tax reduction for donations to approved charities
programmes.amount_note: 30% reduction (from AJ2026, previously 45%) on gifts of 40 EUR or more to approved institutions, within legal caps (10% of net income, absolute maximum applies)
programmes.source_snippet: Tax reduction for donations of at least 40 EUR per year and per approved institution; the rate drops from 45% to 30% from assessment year 2026

programmes.name_local: Verhoging belastingvrije som voor kinderen ten laste
programmes.name_en: Increased tax-free allowance for dependent children
programmes.amount_note: Tax-free allowance supplement per child, rising with the number of children; automatically applied via the tax return (household composition)
programmes.source_snippet: Each dependent child raises the parents' tax-free allowance; the supplements for the first two children are being increased to 2.650 EUR per child by 2029

programmes.name_local: Bijkomende verhoging belastingvrije som alleenstaande ouder
programmes.name_en: Additional tax-free allowance for single parents
programmes.amount_note: Extra supplement on top of the child supplements; conditions on living situation checked via the population register
programmes.source_snippet: Extra tax-free allowance supplement for a taxpayer living alone with at least one dependent child; from 2026 reserved to genuinely single parents (no longer for de facto cohabiting parents)

programmes.name_en: Employment bonus for low wages (social + fiscal)
programmes.amount_note: Applied automatically via payroll: lower social contributions each month plus a tax reduction via the withholding tax; maximum fiscal bonus 765 EUR (2025) rising to 970 EUR from income year 2026

eligibility.income_note: For reference monthly wages below about 3.271 EUR gross

programmes.source_snippet: Social work bonus reduces the employee's 13,07% social contributions for low wages (referteloon up to about 3.271 EUR); the fiscal work bonus adds a tax reduction of 33,14% (low wages) or 52,54% rising to 63% from income year 2026 (very low wages), capped at 765 EUR rising to 970 EUR

programmes.name_en: Eco-vouchers (tax-free employer benefit)
programmes.amount_note: Maximum 250 EUR per year in eco-vouchers, fully exempt for the employee; granted via collective labour agreement or individual agreement
programmes.source_snippet: Employers can grant eco-vouchers exempt from social contributions and tax, up to 250 EUR per year, usable for ecological products and services

programmes.name_en: SME e-wallet subsidy for training and advice (Flanders)
programmes.amount_note: 30% subsidy (small enterprises) or 20% (medium), max 7.500 EUR/year; 45%/35% for sustainability-energy and digitalisation-cybersecurity themes; only registered providers

procedure_steps.detail: Enrol with a registered provider, then apply online via the e-loket within 14 days after the start
Pay your own contribution to the e-wallet; VLAIO adds the subsidy and you pay the provider through it

programmes.source_snippet: "Kleine ondernemingen krijgen 30% steun, middelgrote ondernemingen 20%. Je kan maximaal 7.500 steun per jaar krijgen." Higher rates (45%/35%) for energy-efficiency and cybersecurity themes; since 1 Feb 2026 advice only for cybersecurity.

programmes.name_en: Investment deduction for companies
programmes.amount_note: Percentage of the investment value deductible from taxable income; ordinary rate 8%, thematic deduction for listed sustainable investments at higher rates; carry-forward possible
programmes.source_snippet: Companies (mainly SMEs) can deduct a percentage of qualifying investments from taxable profit: 8% ordinary one-off deduction, higher thematic deduction (up to 20-25% and more for energy/climate/R&D investments from 2025)

programmes.name_local: Tax shelter voor startende en groeiende ondernemingen
programmes.name_en: Tax shelter for start-ups and scale-ups (private investors)
programmes.amount_note: Tax reduction on the invested amount; investor cap 100.000 EUR/year; company cap 250.000 EUR (start-up) or 500.000 EUR (growth) raised per period
programmes.source_snippet: Private investors get a tax reduction of 45% (micro), 30% (small) or 25% (growth companies) on investments up to 100.000 EUR per year in qualifying young companies

programmes.name_en: Target group reductions of employer social contributions
programmes.amount_note: Quarterly flat or percentage reductions on employer contributions, varying by target group; applied automatically via the DMFA declaration
programmes.source_snippet: Structural reduction of employer social contributions plus target group reductions (first employees, young workers, older workers, low wages...) lowering the cost of hiring

programmes.name_en: Sickness and Invalidity Benefits
programmes.amount_note: First year: generally 60% of capped gross wage; invalidity afterwards: 40-65% depending on family situation (dependants); subject to medical control by the health fund's advising doctor

eligibility.income_note: Based on capped previous wage and household category

programmes.source_snippet: Employees unable to work due to illness or accident receive a primary disability benefit (first year) and afterwards an invalidity benefit, calculated on the capped wage and family situation

programmes.name_en: Maternity Benefit
programmes.amount_note: Percentage of wage with caps for employees; flat weekly amounts for self-employed; paid via the health insurance fund
programmes.source_snippet: Paid maternity leave of 15 weeks (more for multiple births): benefit of about 82% of uncapped wage for the first 30 days, then 75% of the capped wage for employees; self-employed mothers receive a flat weekly benefit

programmes.name_en: Paternity/Co-parent Birth Leave Benefit
programmes.amount_note: 20 days per birth, to be taken within 4 months after birth; 82% of capped daily wage for employees
programmes.source_snippet: Co-parents get 20 days of birth leave after the birth of their child, paid at 82% of the capped wage (employees) or a flat amount (self-employed)

programmes.name_en: Parental Leave Benefit (RVA)
programmes.amount_note: Flat monthly allowance for full-time interruption (roughly 1.000-1.400 EUR gross depending on sector and form); proportional for half-time or 1/5 schemes
programmes.source_snippet: Up to 4 months of full-time (or longer part-time) parental leave per parent per child under 12, with a flat RVA allowance

programmes.name_local: Thematische verloven (palliatief verlof, zorg zwaar ziek gezinslid, zorgkrediet)
programmes.name_en: Thematic care leave schemes (palliative, serious illness)
programmes.amount_note: Flat allowances per interruption scheme, paid monthly; duration depends on the theme (e.g. 1-3 months renewable)

documents_required.doc: Medical certificate of the person needing care

programmes.source_snippet: Employees can fully or partly interrupt their career to provide palliative care, care for a seriously ill family member or a disabled child, with flat RVA allowances higher than ordinary time credit

programmes.name_en: Tax reduction for childcare costs
programmes.amount_note: 45% of actual childcare costs up to a daily cap per child (16,90 EUR income year 2026, 17,30 EUR income year 2027); declared with the childcare institution's attestation
programmes.source_snippet: 45% tax reduction on childcare expenses for children under 14 (or 18/21 with disability), capped at a maximum per day and per child (16,90 EUR/day for income year 2026)

programmes.name_en: Statutory Retirement Pension
programmes.amount_note: Amount depends on career and past wages; minimum rights per career year and a guaranteed minimum pension for full careers exist; application possible online, often automatic

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online via mypension.be or at the municipal administration (automatic in some cases)

programmes.source_snippet: Career-based state pension from the legal pension age (66, rising to 67), calculated on career length and capped career wages, with minimum guarantees per career year

programmes.name_en: Work Accident Insurance (compulsory employer insurance)
programmes.amount_note: Medical care reimbursed in full; daily allowances and permanent incapacity annuities calculated on the capped yearly wage
programmes.source_snippet: Employees are insured by their employer against accidents at work and on the way to work: medical costs fully covered plus compensation for temporary or permanent incapacity

programmes.name_en: Meal vouchers (tax-advantaged employer benefit)
programmes.amount_note: Max 8 EUR per worked day, exempt for the employee; commonly worth roughly 130-170 EUR per month for full-time work
programmes.source_snippet: Employers can grant one meal voucher per worked day, exempt from social contributions and tax, with a maximum face value of 8 EUR (employer pays at least 6,91 EUR, employee at most 1,09 EUR)
